summary: Validated two user-requested changes end-to-end on live preview URL: (1) 'Acheter maintenant' button fully removed on product pages (desktop + mobile) with Add-to-Cart working and 7 size chips visible; (2) New hero editorial photo properly displayed on homepage with independent desktop/mobile framings, character fully visible on mobile, no deformation, no filter/gradient. Harmless but dead code — could be cleaned up.
